filenameDivergence.rationale: The native OOXMLFactory_wml.cxx is build-generated by factoryimpl_ns.py. Its factoryCreateElementMap records have their own native lookup responsibility, distinct from attribute/resource/action and getListValue records. Separate generated data modules retain one namespace factory, one API, all original records and unchanged original generators/model, without a new parser/provider or filename-only ownership split.
